Live football fixtures, scores and match times

Football Live lists the day's football matches with live scores, results and kick-off times converted to your time zone. Use the tabs for yesterday, today and tomorrow, the Live now button to see only games in progress, and the search box to find a team or competition. Open any match for its summary and kick-off times across several countries.

New to following European football? Read our guides: Europe's top leagues explained, how to watch football legally and match times and time zones.
